name: useSatelliteNTN
summary: Whether the device declares satellite messaging support. Connection state, carrier, signal and SOS readiness are not readable through Android's public API and are null.
plain: Tells you whether the phone declares satellite messaging hardware support. Android does not let apps read the satellite connection, carrier, signal strength or SOS readiness, so those fields stay null and unreadReason says why.
description: Reads the android.hardware.telephony.satellite system feature through PackageManager. Android 36's public SatelliteManager only offers register/unregisterStateChangeListener with an enabled-state callback, so there is no public read for connection state, carrier, signal bars, pointing data or emergency readiness. Those fields (connectionState, carrier, signalQualityBars, pointingGuidance, emergencyServicesReady) are always null and unreadReason states the reason.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: True when the device declares the android.hardware.telephony.satellite system feature.

returns.name: connectionState
returns.desc: Always null: Android's public API exposes no satellite connection state.

returns.name: carrier
returns.desc: Always null: Android's public API exposes no satellite carrier.

returns.name: signalQualityBars
returns.desc: Always null: Android's public API exposes no satellite signal strength.

returns.name: pointingGuidance
returns.desc: Always null: Android's public API exposes no satellite pointing data.

returns.name: emergencyServicesReady
returns.desc: Always null: Android's public API exposes no satellite emergency readiness.

returns.name: unreadReason
returns.desc: Why the null fields are null; null before the first read.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if the query failed.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: 'hardware' when the feature flag says satellite is supported, 'unavailable' otherwise.

agentNote: Only isSupported carries information. Do not branch on connectionState, carrier, signalQualityBars or emergencyServicesReady: they are always null. Do not claim a satellite link or SOS readiness from this hook.
